name: When do I need new gas pipe installation or replacement?

mainEntity.name: When do I need new gas pipe installation or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: New gas pipe installation is typically needed when converting appliances from electric to gas, adding new gas appliances like a range, dryer, or outdoor grill, or extending gas lines to a new area of your property. Replacement becomes necessary if existing pipes are old, corroded, leaking, or no longer meet current safety codes. Visible damage, a persistent rotten egg smell, or unexpectedly high gas bills can also indicate a need for professional inspection and potential replacement. Always consult a qualified plumber for an assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: New gas pipe installation is needed for new gas appliances or system expansion. Replacement is necessary for old, damaged, or leaking pipes.
